lines.text:
I came here with some friends to catch us some
Bug-type Pokémon!\c
My pals are all itching to get into some
Pokémon battles!

I was throwing Poké Balls to catch Pokémon, and
I ran out of them.\c
That’s why you can never have too many
Poké Balls.
Trainer Tips\c\nShake your Joy-Con when it’s not attached to\nyour system, and you can play with your partner!

Trainer Tips\c
For poison, use Antidote!
For paralysis, use Paralyze Heal!\c
Get them at Poké Marts!
Trainer Tips\c\nVisit Professor Oak at his research lab to have\nhim check out your progress on your Pokédex!

Trainer Tips\c
If you catch a Pokémon, the Pokémon in your
party can earn Exp. Points!\c
If you catch an unusually large Pokémon, you’ll
get even more Exp. Points!\c
...Small Pokémon work, too!

Trainer Tips\c
How you try to catch a Pokémon depends on
the kind of controller you’re using.\c
If you change your controller, you can check
the Help option that appears on\c
the Pokémon-catching screen for
a quick tutorial!
